name: What amenities are most sought after by luxury home buyers in today's Miami market?

mainEntity.name: What amenities are most sought after by luxury home buyers in today's Miami market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Today's luxury home buyers in Miami increasingly prioritize amenities that enhance privacy, wellness, and convenience. Highly sought-after features include private gyms, home offices or dedicated workspaces, smart home technology, resort-style pools, and spacious outdoor living areas. Properties with expansive views, access to private docks, or proximity to exclusive clubs are also in high demand. We observe these trends across various luxury neighborhoods and can advise on how these features impact property appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury buyers in Miami seek amenities like private gyms, home offices, smart home technology, resort-style pools, and spacious outdoor living areas, emphasizing privacy and convenience.
